title: Talabat — 10 Years
service: Campaign art direction, social design, key visuals
blurb: An anniversary campaign where the number 10 becomes the hero: one bold orange card, one clean photo of a real smiling face, one line of Arabic that does the heavy lifting. Built as a modular system that survives carousels, stories and feed placements.
alt: Talabat 10-year social media campaign key visual with orange phone card and Arabic headline
details: One master layout, three crops (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) so the team never re-designs per placement.
Type scale locked to two sizes so Arabic headlines stay readable on a phone at arm’s length.
Colour system: Talabat orange reserved only for the brand cue, everything else neutral so photos breathe.
